<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Checkbox Group - Fruits</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; margin: 2rem; }
    fieldset { border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 8px; max-width: 480px; }
    legend { font-weight: 600; padding: 0 .5rem; }
    .options { display: grid; gap: .5rem; margin-top: .5rem; }
    label { cursor: pointer; }
    .note { color: #555; font-size: .9rem; margin-top: .25rem; }
    .actions { margin-top: 1rem; }
    button { padding: .5rem .75rem; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="#" method="post">
    <fieldset>
      <legend>What fruits do you like?</legend>

      <div class="options">
        <div>
          <input type="checkbox" id="bananas" name="fruits[]" value="bananas" />
          <label for="bananas">Bananas</label>
        </div>

        <div>
          <input type="checkbox" id="oranges" name="fruits[]" value="oranges" />
          <label for="oranges">Oranges</label>
        </div>

        <div>
          <input type="checkbox" id="apples" name="fruits[]" value="apples" />
          <label for="apples">Apples</label>

    </fieldset>

</body>

<form id="fruit-form" action="#" method="post">
  <fieldset>
    <legend>What fruits do you like?</legend>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="fruits[]" value="bananas"> Bananas</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="fruits[]" value="oranges"> Oranges</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" name="fruits[]" value="apples"> Apples</label>
  </fieldset>
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('fruit-form');
      const checkboxes = form.querySelectorAll('input[name="fruits[]"]');
      const first = checkboxes[0];

      function validateFruits() {
        const anyChecked = Array.prototype.some.call(checkboxes, function (cb) {
          return cb.checked;
        });
        if (!anyChecked) {
          first.setCustomValidity('You must choose one or more fruits');
        } else {
          first.setCustomValidity('');
        }
      }

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(checkboxes, function (cb) {
        cb.addEventListener('change', validateFruits);
        cb.addEventListener('invalid', validateFruits);
      });

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        validateFruits();
        if (!form.checkValidity()) {
          e.preventDefault();
          form.reportValidity();
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
</form>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <title>Accessible Checkbox Group - Fruits</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <h1>What fruits do you like?</h1>

    <form id="fruit-form" novalidate>
      <fieldset id="fruit-fieldset"
                role="group"
                aria-labelledby="fruit-legend"
                aria-describedby="fruit-error">
        <legend id="fruit-legend">What fruits do you like?</legend>

        <div class="options">
          <div>
            <input type="checkbox" id="fruit-bananas" name="fruits" value="bananas">
            <label for="fruit-bananas">Bananas</label>
          </div>
          <div>
            <input type="checkbox" id="fruit-oranges" name="fruits" value="oranges">
            <label for="fruit-oranges">Oranges</label>
          </div>
          <div>
            <input type="checkbox" id="fruit-apples" name="fruits" value="apples">
            <label for="fruit-apples">Apples</label>
          </div>
        </div>

        <p id="fruit-error" class="error" role="alert" aria-live="assertive" hidden>
          You must choose one or more fruits
        </p>
      </fieldset>

      <button type="submit">Submit</button>
    </form>
  </main>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Pick a color</title>
  <style>
    :root { color-scheme: light dark; }
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 2rem; }
    .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; }
    .swatch { width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: .25rem; background: #000; }
    code { padding: .15rem .35rem; border-radius: .25rem; background: #f3f3f3; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="row">
    <label for="colorPicker">Pick a color</label>
    <input id="colorPicker" type="color" value="#0d6efd" aria-describedby="colorValue" />
    <span class="swatch" id="swatch" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <code id="colorValue">#0d6efd</code>
  </div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const picker = document.getElementById('colorPicker');
      const swatch = document.getElementById('swatch');
      const valueEl = document.getElementById('colorValue');

      function update() {
        swatch.style.background = picker.value;
        valueEl.textContent = picker.value;
      }

      picker.addEventListener('input', update);
      update();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Pick a color</title>
  <style>
    :root { color-scheme: light dark; }
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 2rem; }
    .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .preview { width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 0.4rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.04); }
    .value { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 7ch; }
    label { font-weight: 600; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="row" role="group" aria-labelledby="color-label">
    <label id="color-label" for="colorPicker">Pick a color</label>
    <input id="colorPicker" name="color" type="color" value="#3b82f6" aria-describedby="colorValue" />
    <span id="colorValue" class="value" aria-live="polite">#3B82F6</span>
    <div id="preview" class="preview" role="img" aria-label="Selected color preview"></div>
  </div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const picker = document.getElementById('colorPicker');
      const valueEl = document.getElementById('colorValue');
      const preview = document.getElementById('preview');

      function update() {
        const val = picker.value.toUpperCase();
        valueEl.textContent = val;
        preview.style.background = val;
      }

      picker.addEventListener('input', update);
      update();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

        <label for="color-hex" id="color-hex-label">Hex color (RGB hex: #RRGGBB)</label>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; margin-top:4px;">
          <input
            id="color-hex"
            name="color-hex"
            type="text"
            inputmode="latin"
            autocomplete="off"
            spellcheck="false"
            aria-labelledby="color-hex-label"
            aria-describedby="color-help color-value"

            pattern="^#?([0-9a-fA-F]{6})$"

            id="color-preview"
            role="img"
            aria-label="Selected color preview"
            title="Selected color"

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Accessible Document Upload</title>
  <style>
    :root { color-scheme: light dark; }
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 2rem; line-height: 1.5; }
    .field { margin-block: 1rem; max-width: 40rem; }
    label { font-weight: 600; display: inline-block; margin-bottom: .375rem; }
    .help { font-size: .9375rem; color: #555; margin-top: .375rem; }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      .help { color: #c9c9c9; }
    }
    .file-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    input[type="file"] { font: inherit; }
    .file-name { min-height: 1.25rem; }
    button.clear-btn {
      border: 1px solid currentColor;
      background: transparent;
      padding: .375rem .625rem;
      border-radius: .375rem;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    button.clear-btn:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: not-allowed; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="#" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data">

        id="document-upload"
        name="document"
        type="file"
        accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx,.ppt,.pptx,.txt,.rtf,.odt,.ods,.odp,.csv"
        aria-describedby="document-help document-filename"

      spellcheck="false"

<form id="profile-form" novalidate>
  <div class="field">
    <label for="desired-email">Desired email address <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
    <p id="desired-email-help" class="help">Use a format like name@example.com.</p>
    <input
      id="desired-email"
      name="desiredEmail"
      type="email"
      inputmode="email"
      autocomplete="email"
      required
      aria-required="true"
      aria-describedby="desired-email-help desired-email-error"
      aria-invalid="false"
    />
    <p id="desired-email-error" class="error" role="alert" aria-live="assertive"></p>
  </div>
  <button type="submit">Save</button>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('profile-form');
      const input = document.getElementById('desired-email');
      const errorEl = document.getElementById('desired-email-error');

      function setError(message) {
        errorEl.textContent = message || '';
        input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', message ? 'true' : 'false');
      }

      function validate() {
        const value = input.value.trim();
        if (!value) {
          setError('Please enter the desired email address.');
          return false;
        }
        // Use native validation for type/format; add a friendly message.
        if (!input.checkValidity()) {
          setError('Please enter a valid email address (e.g., name@example.com).');
          return false;
        }
        setError('');
        return true;
      }

      input.addEventListener('input', validate);
      input.addEventListener('blur', validate);

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        if (!validate()) {
          e.preventDefault();
          input.focus();
        }
      });
    })();
  </script

<form id="emailForm" novalidate>
  <label for="email">Email Address</label>
  <input
    id="email"
    name="email"
    type="email"
    required
    aria-describedby="emailError"
    aria-invalid="false"
  />
  <p id="emailError" role="alert" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const emailInput = document.getElementById('email');
      const emailError = document.getElementById('emailError');
      const form = document.getElementById('emailForm');

      function updateError() {
        if (emailInput.validity.valid) {
          emailError.textContent = '';
          emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
        } else {
          emailError.textContent = 'Your email address is invalid.';
          emailInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        }
      }

      emailInput.addEventListener('input', updateError);
      emailInput.addEventListener('blur', updateError);

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        updateError();
        if (!emailInput.validity.valid) {
          e.preventDefault();
          emailInput.focus();
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
</form>

        minlength="8"
        required
        aria-describedby="passwordError"
        aria-invalid="false"

        errorEl.hidden = true;
        input.classList.remove('invalid');
        input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
      }

      function validate() {
        const value = input.value;
        if (value.length === 0) {
          hideError();
          return true;
        }
        if (value.length < 8) {
          showError();
          return false;
        }
        hideError();
        return true;
      }

      input.addEventListener('input', validate);
      input.addEventListener('blur', validate);

      document.getElementById('passwordForm').addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        if (!validate()) {
          e.preventDefault();
          input.focus();
        }
      });
    })();

  <fieldset>
    <legend>Theme</legend>
    <label>
      <input type="radio" name="theme" value="light"> Light
    </label>
    <label>
      <input type="radio" name="theme" value="dark"> Dark
    </label>
    <label>
      <input type="radio" name="theme" value="high-contrast"> High contrast
    </label>

  <p id="theme-error" class="error" role="alert" aria-live="polite" hidden>You must choose a theme to proceed</p>

  <button type="submit">Continue</button>
</form>

<script>
  (function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('theme-form');
    const errorEl = document.getElementById('theme-error');

    function showError(msg) {
      errorEl.textContent = msg;
      errorEl.hidden = false;
    }

    function clearError() {
      errorEl.hidden = true;
    }

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      const selected = form.querySelector('input[name="theme"]:checked');
      if (!selected) {
        e.preventDefault();
        showError('You must choose a theme to proceed');
      } else {
        clearError();
      }
    });

    form.addEventListener('change', function () {
      const anyChecked = form.querySelector('input[name="theme"]:checked');
      if (anyChecked) clearError();
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('themeForm');
    const errorEl = document.getElementById('theme-error');
    const radios = form.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme"]');

    function getSelected() {
      return form.querySelector('input[name="theme"]:checked');
    }

    function showError() {
      errorEl.hidden = false;
      radios.forEach(r => {
        r.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        r.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'theme-error');
      });
    }

    function clearError() {
      errorEl.hidden = true;
      radios.forEach(r => {
        r.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Volume Range Slider</title>
</head>
<body>
    <label for="volume">Volume</label>
    <input 
        type="range" 
        id="volume" 
        name="volume" 
        min="1" 
        max="10" 
        value="5" 
        aria-valuemin="1" 
        aria-valuemax="10" 
        aria-valuenow="5"
        aria-label="Volume level from 1 to 10"
    >
    <output for="volume" aria-live="polite">5</output>
    
    <script>
        const slider = document.getElementById('volume');
        const output = document.querySelector('output');
        
        slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
            output.textContent = this.value;
            this.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', this.value);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

  <title>Read-only User ID Field</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; margin: 2rem; }
    .field { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; font-weight: 600; }
    input[readonly] {
      width: 320px;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      border: 1px solid #c8c8c8;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #f6f6f6;
      color: #333;
      outline: none;
    }
  </style>

    <div class="field">
      <label for="userId">User ID</label>
      <input
        id="userId"
        name="userId"
        type="text"
        value="12345"
        readonly
        aria-readonly="true"
        aria-describedby="userIdHelp"
      />
      <div id="userIdHelp" style="font-size: 0.9rem; color: #666; margin-top: 0.35rem;">

      </div>
    </div>
  </form>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Theme Selector</title>
  <style>
    :root { color-scheme: light dark; }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji";
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .wrap {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 2rem auto;
      padding: 0 1rem;
    }
    label { font-weight: 600; }
    select {
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }
    .card {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      padding: 1rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);
    }
    /* Themes */
    body.theme-light {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #111111;
    }
    body.theme-light .card {
      background: #f6f8fa;
      border-color: #d0d7de;
    }

    body.theme-dark {
      background: #0b0f14;
      color: #e6edf3;
    }
    body.theme-dark .card {
      background: #111827;
      border-color: #2b3440;
    }

    body.theme-high-contrast {
      background: #000000;
      color: #ffff00;
      /* Improve legibility in high contrast */
      text-shadow: none;
    }
    body.theme-high-contrast .card {
      background: #000000;
      border: 3px solid #ffff00;
    }
    body.theme-high-contrast a {
      color: #ffff00;
    }
    /* Focus visibility */
    :focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid #3b82f6;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { transition: none !important; animation: none !important; }
    }
  </style>

<fieldset>
  <legend>Theme</legend>
  <label for="theme-select">Choose theme</label>
  <select id="theme-select" name="theme" aria-describedby="theme-help">
    <option value="light">Light</option>
    <option value="dark">Dark</option>
    <option value="high-contrast">High contrast</option>
  </select>
  <p id="theme-help" class="sr-only">Select a color theme. Changes apply immediately and are saved for future visits.</p>
</fieldset>

<script>
  (function () {
    var select = document.getElementById('theme-select');
    var valid = ['light', 'dark', 'high-contrast'];
    var stored = localStorage.getItem('theme');

    function apply(theme) {
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
    }

    if (valid.includes(stored)) {
      select.value = stored;
    } else {
      select.value = 'light';
    }
    apply(select.value);

    select.addEventListener('change', function () {
      var theme = select.value;
      if (valid.includes(theme)) apply(theme);
    });
  })();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Submit Button</title>
  <style>
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      background: #f6f7f9;
    }
    form { margin: 0; }
    .submit-btn {
      appearance: none;
      border: 1px solid #1a73e8;
      background: #1a73e8;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 0.65rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: filter .15s ease, transform .02s ease;
    }
    .submit-btn:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); }
    .submit-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
    .submit-btn:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid #a8c7fa;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="#" method="post">
    <button class="submit-btn" type="submit" aria-label="Submit">Submit</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Accessible Submit Button</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <h1>Accessible submit button example</h1>

    <form id="demo-form" action="#" method="post" novalidate>
      <div>
        <label for="email">Email</label>
        <input id="email" name="email" type="email" required autocomplete="email" inputmode="email" />
      </div>

      <button id="submit-btn" type="submit" aria-describedby="submit-instructions">
        Submit
      </button>

      <!-- Screen-reader-only helper text for the button -->
      <p id="submit-instructions" class="sr-only">
        Press the button to submit the form. The button will be disabled while submitting.
      </p>
    </form>

    <!-- Live region for submission feedback -->
    <div id="feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></div>
  </main>

  <style>
    /* Visually hidden but accessible to screen readers */
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }
  </style>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('demo-form');
      const btn = document.getElementById('submit-btn');
      const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback');

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {

      name="orange_color"
      type="text"

    <label for="first-name">Your first name</label>
    <input
      id="first-name"
      name="first_name"
      type="text"
      autocomplete="given-name"
      list="first-name-suggestions"
      spellcheck="false"
      inputmode="text"
      aria-describedby="first-name-help"
      required

    <datalist id="first-name-suggestions">

      <option value="John">
      <option value="Jane">
      <option value="Alex">
    </datalist>
    <div id="first-name-help">Start typing to see suggestions. Press the down arrow to select.</div>
  </form>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Color Question</title>

      margin-top: 0.35rem;

  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form id="colorForm" novalidate>
    <label for="colorAnswer">What color is an orange?</label><br />
    <input
      type="text"
      id="colorAnswer"
      name="colorAnswer"
      required
      aria-describedby="colorError"
      aria-invalid="false"
    />
    <p id="colorError" class="error" role="alert" aria-live="polite" hidden>
      That’s not right. Try again.
    </p>
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
  </form>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('colorForm');
      const input = document.getElementById('colorAnswer');
      const error = document.getElementById('colorError');

      function showError() {
        input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        error.hidden = false;
      }

      function clearError() {
        input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
        error.hidden = true;
      }

      input.addEventListener('input', function () {
        if (input.value.trim().toLowerCase() === 'orange') {
          clearError();
        }
      });

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        const value = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (value !== 'orange') {
          e.preventDefault();
          showError();
          input.focus();
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>

  <label for="message">Message</label>

  <div id="messageError" class="error" role="alert" aria-live="polite" hidden>

<script>
  (function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('contactForm');
    const textarea = document.getElementById('message');
    const errorEl = document.getElementById('messageError');
    const MIN_WORDS = 20;

    function countWords(text) {
      const tokens = text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      return tokens.length;
    }

    function setValidity(isValid) {
      if (isValid) {
        textarea.setCustomValidity('');
        errorEl.hidden = true;
        textarea.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
      } else {
        textarea.setCustomValidity(
          'Your message should be at least 20 words long. Please describe your problem in as much detail as possible.'
        );
        errorEl.hidden = false;
        textarea.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
      }
    }

    function validateMessage() {
      const count = countWords(textarea.value);
      setValidity(count >= MIN_WORDS);
      return textarea.validity.valid;
    }

    textarea.addEventListener('input', validateMessage);
    textarea.addEventListener('blur', validateMessage);

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      if (!validateMessage()) {
        e.preventDefault();
        textarea.focus();
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="6" aria-describedby="messageError" aria-invalid="true" required></textarea>
  <div id="messageError" role="alert" aria-live="polite">
    Your message should be at least 20 words long. Please describe your problem in as much detail as possible.
  </div>
  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
<script>
  (function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('contactForm');
    const textarea = document.getElementById('message');
    const error = document.getElementById('messageError');

    function countWords(text) {
      const matches = text.trim().match(/\b[\p{L}\p{N}'’-]+\b/gu);
      return matches ? matches.length : 0;
    }

    function showError(msg) {
      error.textContent = msg;
      error.style.display = 'block';
      textarea.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    }

    function clearError() {
      error.textContent = 'Your message should be at least 20 words long. Please describe your problem in as much detail as possible.';
      error.style.display = 'none';
      textarea.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'false');
    }

    function validate() {
      const words = countWords(textarea.value);
      if (words < 20) {
        showError('Your message should be at least 20 words long. Please describe your problem in as much detail as possible.');
        return false;
      }
      clearError();
      return true;
    }

    textarea.addEventListener('input', validate);

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
      if (!validate()) {
        e.preventDefault();
        textarea.focus();
      }
    });

    // Initialize as invalid with error visible
    showError('Your message should be at least 20 words long. Please describe your problem in as much detail as possible.');
  })();
</script>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Accessible Message Textarea</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <form action="#" method="post" novalidate>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Send us a message</legend>

        <label for="message">Message <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
        <div id="messageHelp" class="help">Do not include sensitive information.</div>

        <textarea
          id="message"
          name="message"
          rows="6"
          required
          aria-required="true"
          aria-describedby="messageHelp messageCount"
          maxlength="500"
          placeholder="Type your message here"></textarea>

        <div id="messageCount" class="counter" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">500 characters remaining</div>

        <button type="submit">Send</button>
      </fieldset>
    </form>
  </main>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const textarea = document.getElementById('message');
      const counter = document.getElementById('messageCount');
      const max = textarea.maxLength > 0 ? textarea.maxLength : 500;

      function updateCounter() {
        const remaining = max - textarea.value.length;
        counter.textContent = remaining + ' characters remaining';
      }

      textarea.addEventListener('input', updateCounter);
      updateCounter();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  (function() {

    const counter = document.getElementById('messageCounter');
    const MAX = 200;

    function updateCount() {
      const len = textarea.value.length;
      counter.textContent = len + '/' + MAX;
      if (len > MAX) {

      }

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Message with Character Counter</title>
</head>
<body>
  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="5" maxlength="200" aria-describedby="message-counter"></textarea>
  <div id="message-counter" aria-live="polite">0/200</div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const textarea = document.getElementById('message');
      const counter = document.getElementById('message-counter');
      const max = parseInt(textarea.getAttribute('maxlength'), 10) || 200;

      function updateCounter() {
        const length = textarea.value.length;
        counter.textContent = length + '/' + max;
        counter.style.color = length > max ? '#b00020' : '';
      }

      textarea.addEventListener('input', updateCounter);
      textarea.addEventListener('propertychange', updateCounter);
      updateCounter();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

        const len = textarea.value.length;
        counter.textContent = len + '/' + max;

      textarea.addEventListener('input', update);
      textarea.addEventListener('keyup', update);
      update();
    })();
  </script>
</body>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Meeting Time Field</title>
</head>
<body>
  <form id="meeting-form" action="#" method="post">
    <label for="meeting-time">Meeting Time</label>
    <input
      type="time"
      id="meeting-time"
      name="meeting_time"
      required
      step="900"
      aria-describedby="meeting-time-help"
    />
    <small id="meeting-time-help">Use 24-hour time. Step is 15 minutes.</small>
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
  </form>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const form = document.getElementById('meeting-form');
      const timeInput = document.getElementById('meeting-time');

      // Set a default value if none is provided
      if (!timeInput.value) {
        timeInput.value = '09:00';
      }

      form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const data = new FormData(form);
        const value = data.get('meeting_time');
        alert('Meeting Time: ' + value);
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Notification Toggle</title>
    <style>
        .toggle-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
        }
        .toggle-switch {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
            width: 60px;
            height: 34px;
        }
        .toggle-switch input {
            opacity: 0;
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
        }
        .slider {
            position: absolute;
            cursor: pointer;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background-color: #ccc;
            transition: .4s;
            border-radius: 34px;
        }
        .slider:before {
            position: absolute;
            content: "";
            height: 26px;
            width: 26px;
            left: 4px;
            bottom: 4px;
            background-color: white;
            transition: .4s;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }
        input:checked + .slider {
            background-color: #2196F3;
        }
        input:checked + .slider:before {
            transform: translateX(26px);
        }
        .toggle-label {
            font-size: 16px;
            color: #333;
        }
        .toggle-note {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #666;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="toggle-container">
        <label class="toggle-switch">
            <input type="checkbox">
            <span class="slider"></span>
        </label>
        <div>
            <div class="toggle-label">Notifications</div>
            <div class="toggle-note">Turn alerts on or off.</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</body>
</html>
